questions.question: The historical portrait of Josiah Willard Gibbs is currently credited only to the article author’s archive. Please identify the actual creator of the portrait or photograph, provide a verifiable public source, and confirm the image’s rights status in both editions.

localizations.source: The historical portrait of Josiah Willard Gibbs is currently credited only to the article author’s archive. Please identify the actual creator of the portrait or photograph, provide a verifiable public source, and confirm the image’s rights status in both editions.
localizations.ru: У исторического портрета Джозайи Уилларда Гиббса сейчас указан только архив автора статьи. Нужны фактический создатель портрета или фотографии, проверяемый публичный источник и подтверждённый правовой статус изображения; сведения следует синхронно указать в обеих версиях.

questions.resolution: The editors accepted the reviewed version for publication. See https://github.com/Fuzzy-Technologies/history_math/pull/532#pullrequestreview-6040077699

questions.question: After the main text was corrected, the titles and descriptions of both editions still retain the unsupported characterization of Gibbs as habitually taciturn; the Nature source confirms only his remark after a discussion of languages and mathematics.
